blockers.description: Deal stage tracking must stay lightweight and avoid becoming a full CRM in June.
blockers.workaround: Use explicit stage fields/statuses only; defer rich activity history.

decisions.decision: Interest does not automatically create an active pursuit.
decisions.rationale: Staff must remain the decision gate.

decisions.decision: Only one active pursuit is allowed per opportunity.
decisions.rationale: Prevents multiple repreneurs being treated as the live deal path at the same time.

decisions.decision: Dropping the active pursuit reopens the opportunity.
decisions.rationale: The team can recover if the live path fails without losing prior matching history.
